name: subtitle
description: A short text shown below the title, e.g. to describe or summarize the content.

name: icon
description: The name of the icon shown in front of the title. The content gets indented to align with the title.

name: expandable
description: Determines if the content can be collapsed and expanded by clicking the header. Use `v-model:expanded` to control or observe the state.

name: titleTag
description: The html tag being used to render the section heading.
